name: goofile
highlights: -d — the domain to search - optional (ie. kali.org
-f — the filetype to search for - required (ie. pdf)
-k — Google Custom Search Engine API key - optional
-e — Google Custom Search Engine ID - optional
-q — Only search for files with keyword - optional
--logging — Set the logging verbosity to something other than "INFO" - optional
usage: goofile [-h] [-d DOMAIN] [-f FILETYPE] [-k KEY] [-e ENGINE] [-q QUERY]
